question: Launched by the former Vice-President Jagdeep Dhankhar in May 2025, who is the author of the book ‘Chunautiyan Mujhe Pasand Hain’?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Anandiben Patel**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• **'Chunautiyan Mujhe Pasand Hain'** is a book authored by **Anandiben Patel**, who is an Indian politician and the current governor of Uttar Pradesh (as of 2023).
 
• The book was launched by the former Vice-President of India, **Jagdeep Dhankhar**, in May 2025.
 
• Anandiben Patel has served as the **first female Chief Minister of Gujarat** from 2014 to 2016.
 
• The book reflects her life experiences, challenges, and her journey as a political leader and administrator.
 
• Anandiben Patel is known for her contributions to education, women’s empowerment, and rural development during her tenure in public service.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Santosh Kumar Gangwar**

 
 
• He is a senior Indian politician and a member of the Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP).
 
• Gangwar has served as the Minister of State for Labour and Employment in the Government of India.
 
• He has been actively involved in legislative matters and has represented Bareilly constituency in the Lok Sabha multiple times.
 
 
 
• **Thaawarchand Gehlot**
 
 
• He is an Indian politician and the current Governor of Karnataka (as of 2023).
 
• Gehlot has previously served as the Minister of Social Justice and Empowerment in the Union Government.
 
• He has been a strong advocate for the rights of marginalized communities and has worked extensively for their upliftment.
 
 
 
• **Pratap Shukla**
 
 
• He is an Indian politician and member of the Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP).
 
• Shukla has served as the Governor of Himachal Pradesh.
 
• He has a significant political career and has contributed to the development of his home state, Uttar Pradesh.
